kapak.alt: Regular tones lead to false positive responses

youtube.baslik: Why is presenting tones in a steady rhythm a mistake? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Presenting tones in a regular rhythm lets the patient predict the next tone, which leads to false positive responses. False positives make the threshold look better than it really is, so the silent intervals between tones are kept irregular.

instagram.kanca: Why is presenting tones in a steady rhythm a mistake?
bilgiler: A response when no tone was presented is a false positive.
A steady rhythm lets the patient predict the next tone.
So the silent intervals between tones are kept irregular.

sahneler.metin: Why is a steady *rhythm* a mistake?
cumleler: Why is presenting tones in a steady rhythm a mistake?
A regular rhythm lets the patient predict the next tone.
A response when no tone was given is a false positive.
False positives make the threshold look better than it is.
So the silent intervals between tones are kept irregular.
